question: The volume of one mole of a gas is changed from $V$ to $2V$ at constant pressure $p$. If $\gamma$ is the ratio of specific heats of the gas, the change in internal energy of the gas is
solution: $$\Delta U = nC_V\Delta T = \frac{nR\Delta T}{\gamma - 1} = \frac{p\,\Delta V}{\gamma - 1} = \frac{p(2V - V)}{\gamma - 1} = \frac{pV}{\gamma - 1}$$
